official.row: 圣约翰大学：思颜堂／华东政法学院：学生宿舍40号楼
official.identity: Yen Hall, named for Yen Yung-kiung (颜永京). Western floor group formerly housed students. The second floor of the east hall housed the auditorium in which Sun Yat-sen spoke on February 1, 1913. School 40 is separate from 4 (administration), 41 (Schereschewsky), 42, 43 (Mann Hall) and 22.
official.stage: Modern campus archive published November 1, 2022. The actual photographic dates of its four architectural stations are unspecified. November 2026 reporting indicates a later restoration had begun. No claim of post-restoration survey.
